facts.label: Name
facts.value: 澄怀园 (翰林花园) Chenghuai Yuan (Hanlin Huayuan)

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Garden of Clear Heart, the Hanlin academicians' garden

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: in use as the residence of the 南书房 / 上书房 officials (S1204); its 近光楼 (6 bays) and duty rooms (8 bays) burned Oct 1860 (明善's memorial via S1207)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: S01 label read (buildings.csv QC60 翰林花园, 'S01 sure'; no buildings drawn); its extent, a circle of 120 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Kangxi-era 索额图's house, then the 内务府; under Yongzheng a temporary school for the princes, then given to 张廷玉 and eight other 上书房 officials; named 澄怀 in Yongzheng 5 (1727) (S1204, 北京晚报 2024). '位于圆明园东南' (S1204) fits the S01 label south of the wall west of 绮春园. 古藤书屋 wisteria (S223). S01 places it outside Qichun Yuan proper.; Lead (S1222): south of 福园门, sharing a wall with 绮春园's west wall.
